pins.head: A DESK IN THE FAR CORNER
pins.title: Studio Apartment: Put the Desk in the Far Corner, Away From the Bed
pins.desc: A desk at the foot of the bed turns the whole room into a bedroom you work in. Push it to the far corner by the window instead and the sleeping end stays out of your eyeline all day, which is most of what a wall would have done for you anyway. Contains affiliate links. #StudioApartment #SmallSpaceLiving #WorkFromHome
pins.alt: A wooden desk and chair in the corner of a bright studio apartment beside tall windows, with a round woven rug and a teal sofa to one side.

pins.head: THE POUCH HOLDS MORE
pins.title: Moisturizer: Price the Refill Pouch by the Ounce, Not by the Pack
pins.desc: A refill pouch looks cheaper because the number on it is smaller, but it also holds more. Divide the price by the fluid ounces on both the pouch and the jar and the comparison takes ten seconds. Sometimes the pouch wins by half, sometimes it barely wins at all. Contains affiliate links. #SkincareRefills #CostPerOunce #BathroomRoutine
pins.alt: A large plain refill pouch standing on a white bathroom counter beside an open glass jar of cream, with folded towels on the shelf behind.

pins.head: SUCTION CUPS LET GO
pins.title: Small Bathroom: A Corner Caddy Holds Shower Bottles Without Suction Cups
pins.desc: Suction cups let go in a warm shower, usually in the middle of the night. A tension caddy wedged into the corner carries the same bottles on friction alone, holds its height for months, and comes out with the rest of your things when the lease ends. Contains affiliate links. #ShowerStorage #RenterFriendly #SmallBathroom
pins.alt: A corner shower caddy of bottles inside a glass shower beside a teal towel on a hook, with a white shelf of baskets and rolled towels over the toilet to the left.

pins.head: TEST A CORNER FIRST
pins.title: Permanent or Removable Vinyl: Test a Scrap Before You Cut the Sheet
pins.desc: The label on the roll tells you what the vinyl is, not how it will behave on your surface. Stick a scrap in a corner, leave it a day, then lift it. If it peels clean you wanted removable; if it fights you it was permanent all along, and you learned that on an offcut. Contains affiliate links. #VinylCrafts #CricutTips #DecalMaking
pins.alt: Two rolls of adhesive vinyl, one terracotta and one cream, lying on a pale wooden craft table beside a flat sheet of backing paper.

pins.head: THE KIT BRINGS ITS MOLDS
pins.title: Epoxy Resin Starter Kit With Coaster Molds, Mica Powder and Tools
pins.desc: Buying resin, hardener, molds, pigment and stir sticks separately means five deliveries and a guess at every quantity. A starter kit that already carries the coaster molds gets you to a first pour in one order, and the molds flex enough to release a cured disc without a knife. Contains affiliate links. #ResinArt #EpoxyResin #CraftKits
pins.alt: Hands lifting a cured amber resin disc out of a round silicone mold on a black work mat, with finished discs and empty molds beside it.

pins.head: TURN THE DESK SIDEWAYS
pins.title: Small Home Office: Put the Window Beside the Desk, Not Behind the Screen
pins.desc: A window behind the screen throws glare across it all afternoon, and a window straight ahead puts the glare in your eyes. Turn the desk so the light arrives from the side and the same corner works from morning to evening without a blind or a second lamp. Contains affiliate links. #HomeOfficeSetup #DeskByTheWindow #SmallSpaceOffice
pins.alt: A light wood desk against a bright window with a potted plant on the sill, a laptop on a wooden stand and a teal chair pulled up to it.

pins.head: CHANGE THE WATER EARLY
pins.title: Acrylic Painting: Change the Rinse Water Before It Greys Your Colors
pins.desc: Grey rinse water carries pigment back onto the brush, and every colour mixed after that lands a shade duller than the one on the palette. Change it when it stops being clear rather than when it turns opaque, and the whites stay white through a whole session. Contains affiliate links. #AcrylicPainting #PaintingTips #ColorMixing
pins.alt: Paint tubes lying on a pine table beside a white divided palette with small dabs of color, a row of brushes, a glass jar and a blank canvas on an easel.

pins.head: KEEP THE LAMP IN REACH
pins.title: Small Bedroom: One Narrow Nightstand Has to Carry the Lamp and the Rest
pins.desc: A small bedroom has room for one bedside surface, so it has to hold the lamp, the glass and whatever you are reading at the same time. Pick the narrowest table that still takes all three and the walking space beside the bed survives. Contains affiliate links. #SmallBedroom #BedsideTable #BedroomOrganization
pins.alt: A bed with a teal duvet beside a small nightstand with a lit lamp, and a clear storage box pulled partly out from under the bed.

pins.head: A LIST BEATS A MEMORY
pins.sub: A Record You Can Hand Over
pins.title: Supplements: Keep One Written Page Listing Everything in the Cupboard
pins.desc: Labels come off, bottles get decanted, and in a year nobody remembers what was in the amber jar at the back. A single page with the name, the amount and the date opened answers all of that, and it is the page to hand a pharmacist or a doctor who asks. Contains affiliate links. #SupplementRoutine #LabelReading #HealthyHabits
pins.alt: An amber glass supplement bottle on a light wooden counter beside an open notepad with a pencil on it and a glass of water.

pins.head: BOOTS GO ON THE LOW RACK
pins.title: Small Entryway: A Low Shoe Rack Keeps Boots Out of the Doorway
pins.desc: Shoes left where they come off end up in the arc of the door, which is why the door starts sticking. A low rack set to one side gives them a place that is still on the way in, and the floor the door swings over stays empty. Contains affiliate links. #EntrywayOrganization #ShoeStorage #RenterFriendly
pins.alt: A two-tier wooden shoe rack holding shoes and boots beside a coat stand with bags, a narrow console table and a coat on the open front door.

pins.head: UNFLAVORED GOES ANYWHERE
pins.title: Unflavored Whey Isolate That Disappears Into What You Already Drink
pins.desc: A flavoured tub commits you to one flavour until it is empty. Unflavored isolate stirs into coffee, oats or a smoothie without arguing with any of them, so a 1 lb tub of about 14 servings gets used up instead of abandoned halfway. Keep the scoop in the tub and a shaker by the sink. Contains affiliate links. #ProteinPowder #WheyIsolate #DailyNutrition
pins.alt: A large cream tub of protein powder beside a clear shaker bottle with a grey lid and a folded towel on a wooden kitchen counter.

pins.head: DAILY DISHES STAY OUT
pins.sub: Open Shelf for the Short List
pins.title: Small Kitchen: Keep Only the Dishes You Use Daily on the Open Shelf
pins.desc: An open shelf is cheap storage and expensive display at the same time. Put the plates and mugs you reach for every day on it and leave the rest behind a door, and the shelf stops looking cluttered without you tidying it once. Contains affiliate links. #SmallKitchen #OpenShelving #KitchenOrganization
pins.alt: An open shelf of stacked plates and bowls above a kitchen counter beside a sink, with a striped towel hanging on the oven door.
